summary: Ryanair furnished a 6-K carrying its H1 FY27 results and capital-return announcements. The company reported H1 PAT of €2.15bn, down 15% on lower fares and doubled unhedged fuel costs, alongside traffic growth of 6% to 125.8m. The board declared an interim dividend of €0.273/share payable late February 2027 and a fresh €800m buyback beginning February, expected to run roughly ten months. This follows completion of a €750m programme (about 28.6m shares cancelled) in September. Watch execution pace and fuel-hedge roll-offs.
